items.comments: We could not have asked for a more perfect place to stay. The location is a quiet verdant neighborhood with interesting shops a walk or quick drive away, and about one minute from the I-5, putting the whole metro area within a 15 minute drive. Getting to the university was easy too. Allison and Crai were so nice, and Crai's recommendations were excellent. The space was very private and clean.

Alison and Crai's apartment was a lovely and perfect destination for a weekend getaway in Seattle. The accommodations were comfortable, private, sizely, and accessible. Alison and Crai were gracious hosts, even providing us with fresh baked cookies upon our arrival, and a fresh supply of coffee and teas. 

The location was perfect. The town of Wallingford is charming, and Crai (as an accomplished travel writer) proved to be a great resource in navigating the trip. There is plenty to do in the neighborhood, as well as easy access to transportation should you want to go elsewhere. 

The pair made coordinating very easy and were great to work with. 

I highly recommend this apartment.

Had a great stay here. Unit is very roomy and quite seperate from the hosts since it has its own entrance. Very peaceful neighborhood with lots of things nearby. Would recommend to anyone needing a place to stay right in Wallingford. 

Unit had everything we needed during our stay like soap and towels.
